title: Update recent_activity_overflow_test.dart's hand-copied _AllTimeSummaryRow to match the shipped _AllTimeStatPhrase tile and exercise Hebrew locale
rule: TQ-8 (assertions/fixtures weaker than what the source can do wrong) + Feathers seam lens
why: The file's own header says it reproduces 'the *exact* post-fix layout shape' of a Row that has twice overflowed for real (its own docstring: 'pushed the Row wider than the card'). Production's _AllTimeSummaryCard row now renders _AllTimeStatPhrase (a single Center+Text ICU-plural phrase, added for the singular/plural active-days fix) as its first child, but the test's _AllTimeSummaryRow still hand-copies three _AllTimeStat (value+label) tiles and never renders _AllTimeStatPhrase at all -- that widget type is completely unguarded. Compounding it, none of the 3 testWidgets in this file passes locale: Locale('he') to expectNoOverflowAcrossDevices, so it defaults to English; the fixture strings ('Active days', 'Mishnayos with a long curriculum name') are also English stand-ins, not the actual Hebrew ICU-plural phrases or Hebrew curriculum labels that ship in this RTL-first app. A regression in the untested _AllTimeStatPhrase tile at long Hebrew text would reproduce the exact 'RenderFlex overflowed horizontally' bug this file exists to prevent, and this suite would stay green throughout.
recommendation: Either mark _AllTimeStat/_AllTimeStatPhrase/_AllTimeSummaryCard (and the siyumim milestone-card Row) @visibleForTesting and import the real widgets instead of hand-copying, or extend the copy to include an _AllTimeStatPhrase-equivalent tile and add a Locale('he') case with realistic long Hebrew phrase/curriculum-name content to the matrix.
acceptance_criteria: expectNoOverflowAcrossDevices exercises a tile structurally equivalent to production's _AllTimeStatPhrase (single Center+Text, maxLines:2, titleMedium) with a long Hebrew ICU-plural phrase
at least one case in this file runs with locale: Locale('he') and RTL-length fixture strings
a comment or lint ties the copied widget tree to its production source so future prod changes are forced to touch this file too
mergedFrom: Stop pinning the dead, unlocalized ChartTimeRange.displayName getter with a coverage-chasing test
